custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have a vendor with an unpaid bill on today's date, so the report has rows.
  • Use Google Chrome (or Microsoft Edge) on a desktop: the report's data is cut off with the browser's own blocking tool. Switching Wi-Fi off does not work for this test: ShopView then sends nothing, waits for the connection and shows no message (as before this release).
  • Run it on staging. On a QA site the page shows the result for about 5 seconds, then the site's own "QA env is sleeping" notice moves it to an "Environment Sleeping" page, so only the first steps can be judged there.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/P Unpaid Invoices (Reports, then "A/P Unpaid Invoices" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu; the page title reads "A/P Unpaid Invoices Report").
custom_steps:
1. Block the report's data: press F12, click the ⋮ menu at the top right of the panel that opens, choose More tools, then Network request blocking; tick "Enable network request blocking", click +, type *reporting/reports* and click Add. Leave the panel open.
  2. Change the as-of date to yesterday.
  3. Unblock it: in the Network request blocking panel, untick "Enable network request blocking".
